messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — starting modular adapter fusion for customer `Zenith`. Planning to merge three LoRA deltas into `redwood/base-3b` today. Need a quick compat check + int4 smoke + the Zenith eval pack run. Anyone free to run tokenizer checks and the quick evals?

claire: On it, pulling repo now. Which merge order and tokenizer should I use? Any special prompt set? :eyes:

sanjay: Use merge order lora_a -> lora_b -> lora_c (that's what customer delivered). Seed=42. Tokenizer: HF `redwood/base-3b-tokenizer-v1`. Prompts live in `evals/zenith_qapack.txt`. Merge command I'm planning to run:
```
python tools/merge_lora.py --base redwood/base-3b --lora ./lora_a.pt,./lora_b.pt,./lora_c.pt --out builds/zenith-merged --seed 42
```

mike: Quick heads-up: lora_b modifies embedding projection, so possible token-id shift risk. I'll run the tokenizer consistency check first: `python tools/check_token_shift.py builds/zenith-merged --ref-tokenizer redwood/base-3b-tokenizer-v1`

anya: Did a fast int4 smoke on a local dev VM earlier (not the merged one, but baseline int4 config) — saw ~0.6% answer-flip on QA_set_A with the same prompts. Pushed diffs to artifacts: `s3://redwood-evals/zenith/1734567890/diff.json`.

claire: Thanks. I'll run the full Zenith eval pack against the merged artifact once tokenizer check is clean, then kick off perf bench on dedicated pool (pool-dedicated-1). ETA ~45m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kicked job `r-7732` to `pool-dedicated-1` for model `zenith-merged` — estimated start in ~5m, job ETA 35m.

mike: If tokenizer-check reports token-shift > 1% we should attempt remapping (`tools/remap_tokens.py`) before accepting the merge. Also log the exact random seed and merge-order in the model metadata (`metadata.json`).

sanjay: Agreed. If regression > 2% on the QA pack we abort the merge and try alternate ordering + single-adapter ablations. I'll watch the artifacts bucket and update here. :thumbsup:

claire: Starting tokenizer check now. Will post short summary and the perf job link when ready.

mike: ping me if you want me to run a quick calibration pass with `--prefill-cache` to check KV-cached latency differences under int4.

sanjay: Good plan. Thanks team — will monitor and coordinate with Solutions for Zenith once we have numbers.
